caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bed with a tall, ornate headboard and a matching footboard, both featuring geometric and curved designs. The bed is colored in various shades of brown and tan, with darker brown and black outlining that defines the shapes and decorative elements. The headboard is triangular at the top, with an orange and brown finial and expanded by decorative scrollwork extensions on either side. It contains inset circular and rectangular panels, emphasized by darker accents. The footboard is similarly styled with a central raised triangular section and geometric insets bordered with black. Draped over the left and right corners of the footboard are two light blue cloths, each hanging downward to the floor. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or patterns.
title: Bed
